name: Heir Search Caller
normative-structure: The office answers for finding heir search's buyer side (probate/estate attorneys, title companies, heirs'-property nonprofits and USDA Section 2501 grantees, county probate/public administrators, land trusts, tax-forfeit/partition buyers), reading the pulled federal-funder and nonprofit lead lists and the Duluth land business's estate-owned lots as heir search cases, logging every contact, and taking in and pricing an order once a buyer agrees to one — without ever producing the report itself.

x-provenance.authority: the 2026-08-27 note on mission-aligned service markets in land tenure and probate records, and the 2026-09-26 instruction to build heir search as the caller's second product

theory-basis: rendanheyi/ren-dan-chou: an order is priced and recorded only under this office's admitted intake, not asserted by a caller directly to a buyer
four-valued-reading-families: buyer contact is read on FOUR's extremal family (unknown/held/denied/contested), never collapsed to a single flag
